com.dailyaiagents.federation.full_description: One-shot skill that splits docs/methodology.md into 8 standalone essays, adds a 2-paragraph intro and "what to read next" footer to each, runs voice-gate (essay surface, threshold 70 HARD) plus scrubber HARD, and auto-publishes passing essays to site/essays/. Drafts that fail either gate land in data/essays/drafts/ for Cooper. Site footer link added to /essays. The build-trap counter — converts existing IP into eight SEO-compounding pages without needing fresh Cooper input.
